# Detrack

Detrack is a delivery management software that offers real-time vehicle tracking, electronic proof of delivery, and automated customer notifications.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/detrack/.

## Actions

- **Add Collection**: Add a new collection in detrack.
- **Delete All Collections**: Delete all collections in the account.
- **Delete All Deliveries**: Delete all deliveries for a specific date.
- **Delete Delivery**: Delete one or more deliveries by date and d.o.
- **Edit Delivery**: Edit specific deliveries by date and d.o.
- **List Jobs**: List all jobs with optional filters and pagination.
- **Search**: Search for deliveries, collections, or vehicles.
- **View All Collections**: View all collection jobs in detrack.
- **View All Deliveries**: View all deliveries for a specific date.
- **View All Vehicles**: View all vehicles in the account.
